name: Backoffice: Shifts form shows staff dropdown, not raw ID input
description: Open the Shifts page, click Add Shift, verify the staff field is a dropdown with staff names (not a text input for raw IDs). Select a staff member, fill the form, save, and verify the new shift appears in the table with the staff name shown.

planSteps.description: Fill in email 'amanuel@fufut.coffee' and password 'selam@336', then click the Sign In or Login button
Verify successful login: URL contains '/backoffice/app/' and the sidebar is visible with navigation items
Click on 'Shifts' or 'Time Clock' section in the sidebar to navigate to the Shifts page
Verify the Shifts page loads with a table showing shift entries and an 'Add Shift' button visible
Click the '+ Add Shift' button to open the add shift form/modal

CRITICAL: Verify the form shows a dropdown select element for Staff (not a plain text input). The dropdown should display staff names like 'Amanuel' or 'Yonas', not raw IDs like 'Sb4cd9bf1'. There should be a 'Select staff member...' placeholder option.
Click on the Staff dropdown and select any staff member from the list (e.g. one showing a name like 'Amanuel Tadesse')
Fill in the Date field with today's date, set Start Time to '08:00' and End Time to '17:00'
Click the 'Save' button to submit the form
Verify the modal closes and the new shift appears in the shifts table below. The Staff column should show a human-readable name, not a raw auto-generated ID.
Verify the user is redirected to /backoffice/login
